tasks_completed.description: Added mcp__happy__change_title to ALWAYS_ALLOWED exemption set in workflow gate hook
tasks_completed.changes: Added ALWAYS_ALLOWED set containing TodoWrite, TodoRead, and mcp__happy__change_title. Tools in ALWAYS_ALLOWED (except TodoWrite which has special bookmark logic) exit(0) immediately before any workflow lock checks.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: the hook blocked all tools except TodoWrite/TodoRead when a workflow is active. mcp__happy__change_title was not exempted, so title changes were blocked during active workflows.

tasks_completed.description: Reverted knownTools.tsx change_title entry to original config and removed duplicate mcp__happy__change_title entry
tasks_completed.changes: Restored hidden: true, minimal: true, noStatus: true on change_title entry. Removed the incorrectly added mcp__happy__change_title entry entirely. The tool should be invisible in the UI since messageToEvent.ts converts it to a native service message.
tasks_completed.rationale: Previous overnight dev incorrectly removed hidden/minimal/noStatus flags and added a duplicate MCP-prefixed entry, which would cause the tool call to render as a visible tool block instead of being hidden.

tasks_completed.changes: Re-added the block that intercepts mcp__happy__change_title tool calls in parseAgentMessage() and converts them to AgentEvent { type: 'message', message: 'Title changed to "X"' }. Also fixed the module comment which incorrectly stated the interception was removed.
tasks_completed.rationale: Previous overnight dev removed this interception (Bug #62 misfix), causing title changes to render as tool blocks instead of native service messages. The original behavior (service message) is correct.

git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Overnight dev session misdiagnosed the title change problem. The actual root cause was the workflow gate hook blocking mcp__happy__change_title. Instead of fixing the hook, the overnight dev modified the app rendering (knownTools.tsx + messageToEvent.ts) to try to make the blocked tool visible -- which was the wrong fix direction.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Task 1 fixes the actual root cause (hook exemption). Tasks 2-3 revert the incorrect app-side workarounds that degraded the title change UX from a clean service message to a visible tool block.

imported_by: GLOBAL: affects all Claude sessions via settings.json hook config

dev.qa_notes: Three verification paths: (1) Trigger mcp__happy__change_title during an active workflow -- should NOT be blocked by the hook. (2) In the app UI, title changes should render as native service messages ('Title changed to X'), NOT as tool call blocks. (3) The change_title entry in knownTools should have hidden:true so if it somehow renders, it stays invisible. Note: Task 1 modifies a global hook file, not worktree code.
dev.tdd_skip_reason: Title change rendering is a UI behavior best verified via Playwright in the browser. The hook exemption is a runtime behavior that requires an active workflow + MCP tool call to test. Neither is programmatically unit-testable in isolation.

recommendations: QA should verify via Playwright: trigger a title change in an active session and confirm it renders as a service message, not a tool block
Consider adding a comment in the workflow gate hook listing what each ALWAYS_ALLOWED tool is for
